reviews.text: Best vet in Dallas! All my friends, and family come here for their animals. Dr. Block never disappoints!

Dr Block has been our vet for 20 years of my various pets (from rescue dogs to my pure bred Dobermans) lifetimes. Dr. Block provides the highest quality of care in the metroplex throughout my dogs being puppies to crossing the rainbow bridge. Compassionate, calm, simple practice, no bells and whistles needed for such quality care that we receive from Cottonwood Animal Hospital.
Kelly is also amazing.
As long as I have pets I will always come to Dr. Block. Definitely recommend!
Both of my dogs enjoy coming here. Helmut is knowledgeable and friendly with the dogs. Price more than fair.
The doctor stayed late on a Friday so that he could see the dog. He was so nice and explained everything and was very patient. I would recommend to anyone!!! Wish I could give more than 5 stars.

I have been to DOZENS of vets. Dr Block is the very best I have seen! We have a very sick puppy (parvo), and I was having trouble getting an appointment…. Richardson vet clinic recommended Cottonwood. I was able to speak to the vet who saw us the next morning. He gave us our options and treated her, sending us home with instructions and medications. She is improving. The office called the next business day to check up with us. I can’t say enough good things about Dr Block. He is extremely knowledgeable and caring. I was very impressed! I absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone who loves their pet!

Just an update… after 10 days, our little Butternut, has made a full recovery from parvo. She is perfect thanks to Dr Block! Thank you! ❤️

Such a wonderful experience! Our cat is not stranger friendly, but the doctor was clearly an expert - you would’ve thought our cat was actually his!!! This was the most pleasant, quiet and calm visit to the vet we’ve ever had and that’s saying a lot! Thank you so much, Dr. Block.
You can tell Dr. Block really cares about your pet and building a relationship with his clients. I highly recommend!

I’m really happy I found this place! I’ve had many unpleasant experiences with vets in the past where i felt they were only interested in the money and not in giving my pets the care they needed. Dr. Block is a very sweet and sincere person. It’s obvious that he has had decades of experience and knows exactly what is necessary. I took my cat to him and she instantly took to liking him. It’s rare to find a vet that’s so good with cats! I felt that compared to other places I have been, the prices were fair and the treatment was great! My cat needed a simple surgery to remove a hernia and the whole procedure didn’t cost me an arm and a leg. At no point did I ever feel like they were pushing for anything that was not necessary. The entire staff is very nice and welcoming. I wish I had come across this clinic when I dealt with my elderly dog last year. I would definitely recommend Dr. Block to everyone!

I have brought my dog in for the past few years. Office staff is great very informative and friendly. Love the vet he explains everything to were i understand and my dog loves him as well. Prices are affordable and the time we have scheduled appointments they are ready before we even check in!
We have been going to Dr. Block for more than 10 years. He is a great vet. Kelly, in the front is awesome too. Dr. Block takes good care of our dogs.

This vet is the best ever. The doctor doesn't overcharge and  he is very good with animals . I have a bluefawn pit bull and always have to muzzle her. She ripped a few of her claws off and was in pain. The Soctor fixed her right up and even gave  me medicine for pain and antibiotics. He wrapped her paws . He did a great job, and this will be my vet from now on.

Dr. Block has made such a difference in my dog’s life! At 13 years old, my chow mix requires special attention, and Dr. Block’s gentle, compassionate care has been amazing. Dr. Block’s expertise and genuine care for animals is evident in …
Dr. Helmut is very nice and caring.

We are new patients of Dr. Block. We couldn’t be anymore pleased with how he runs his practice in regards to our two labs(14,6) he’s treated for various things. Honest, caring, fair priced and easy to talk too. Thank you Dr. Block
Absolutely love the staff and Dr. Block. I don't think there is a better vet for cats in the Dallas area!
Dr. Block is very kind and caring! I found my kitten, Brick, a few months ago and had to make a last minute appointment and the receptionist squeezed me in.
